candidate_requirements.requirement: Request a current neurological and physiological severity assessment or request an equivalent urgent assessment.
candidate_requirements.rationale: A recent seizure with worsening behaviour and current delirium creates an immediate neurological risk independent of the eventual cause.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Current mental state/neurological examination, vital signs and acute seizure/encephalopathy assessment, or a clearly specified urgent neurological/emergency review. An unavailable detailed examination does not invalidate an adequate request.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns; initiate urgent assessment promptly.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek the transplant and immunosuppressive medication history, including relevant exposure or drug-level context.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Transplantation changes the interpretation of neurological deterioration and graft dysfunction and affects the risks of subsequent management.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A general transplant/medication review with current regimen and timing, with a relevant request for drug concentrations or equivalent transplant-team record review. Exact drug names need not be guessed.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request the renal-function and haematological evidence underlying the reported allograft dysfunction and anaemia.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The opening explicitly identifies two additional acute organ-system problems; neither can be safely reduced to an unexplained behavioural presentation.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Renal function plus blood count and haemolysis/smear review, or a clinically equivalent integrated acute transplant/TMA work-up. Requests for previous renal measurements receive credit even when no measured baseline is supplied.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.
